items.title: Show HN: The web is dead. Keep this app alive
items.desc: Longlivethis is a "living" web app that pays for its own hosting an inference. Top proposal gets implemented twice a day! Propose new features and vote on them to help evolve the app and keep it alive. It's an experiment: how long can it stay alive? Propose something cool and help it
items.author: armstrongb
items.descZh: Longlivethis 是一个具有实验性质的“活着”的网络应用，旨在探索社区驱动模式下应用自我维持的极限。其核心功能是允许用户提出新功能提案并进行投票，得票最高的提案每天会被实施两次，以此实现应用的动态演化。该平台的亮点在于它能够自行支付托管和推理费用，通过社区共创保持自我造血能力。高频的每日双次顶级提案实施机制，确保了创意落地的极高效率。它适用于热衷于去中心化协作、渴望参与产品从零到一演化过程的开发者和创意用户。
items.quote: 最佳提案每天实施两次！

items.author: drewlem
items.descZh: Fly or Tesla 是一个在线分析工具，通过比较城市间旅行时飞行和驾驶的成本、时间、充电便利性及碳排放等因素，帮助用户做出更优选择。其核心功能是基于用户实际提交的438次行程数据，动态计算并展示两种交通方式的详细对比，包括每英里费用、所需充电次数和压力评分等指标。亮点在于揭示了关键转折点：大约350英里以上的行程中，飞行开始占优，例如在超过1000英里的行程中，飞行每英里成本为0.33美元，而驾驶为0.26美元，且飞行胜出概率达100%。此外，工具还量化了驾驶压力，显示在900英里以下驾驶更轻松，而长距离则飞行更舒适。该工具适用于计划中长距离旅行的个人或家庭，尤其适合在预算、时间和舒适度之间权衡的决策者。
items.quote: 大约在350英里时，飞行方案开始占优势。
items.titleZh: 在 Hacker News 上分享：分析了 400 条路线，开特斯拉比坐飞机快的概率达 65%

items.author: niliu123
items.descZh: Karmit 是一款完全免费的 Reddit 监控工具，旨在帮助用户实时追踪特定子版块和关键词，以便在目标话题出现的第一时间进行回复，从而有效提升个人 karma 值。该工具支持自定义监控规则，包括精确短语、单个关键词或全版块监控，并允许设置排除词以过滤无关噪音，通过三步简单设置后即可全天候自动运行。其核心亮点在于完全免费（无需信用卡或付费计划）以及极速的推送机制，能在新帖发布后的极短周期内（通常在帖子仍处于早期热度、易于获得曝光时）通过应用和邮件同步送达，且每条提醒均附带目标版块的发帖规则与 flair 要求，防止因技术细节违规删帖。此外，Karmit 提供按版块细分的 karma 变化追踪功能，帮助用户评估哪些社区更具价值，且绝不代发帖或代投票，确保账号安全。它非常适合 SaaS 创业者、开发者、营销人员及独立黑客，用于在早期阶段提供高质量解答、进行合规的品牌推广或收集产品反馈。
items.quote: Karmit 会跟踪你选择的 Reddit 子版块和关键词，一旦有你能回答的帖子上线，就会立刻通知你。

"vite.config.ts") [vite.config.ts](/OlegIGalkin/tendayweekcalendar/blob/main/vite.config.ts "vite.config.ts") View all files Repository files navigation 10Day Week Calendar This project is a small web app for exploring an alternative calendar based on 10day weeks. The idea is inspired by the French Revolutionary calendar, but without the extra complexity of decimal time. App description Imagine a calendar where the week is no longer 7 days long, but 10 days instead. What if we had schedules like 3 on, 1 off, 4 on, 2 off or 3 on, 2 off, 2 on, 3 off? A 10day week would make planning simpler and more flexible, especially for people who work irregular hours or want to organize life differently. In this app, the year is represented as eleven 30day months, followed by a final month of 30+ days to account for the extra days needed to match the solar year. The goal is to make it easier to think about time, routines, and schedules in a fresh way. This app also lets you connect your existing Google Calendar and Google Tasks, as well as Microsoft To Do, so you can see how your plans fit into a 10day week structure. It is designed as a playful experiment in calendar design and a practical tool for people who want to imagine a different way of organizing time. Features Interactive 10day week calendar Customizable dayoff schemes Google Calendar and Google Tasks integration Microsoft To Do integration Year and date selection Simple, browserbased experience License This project is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later (AGPL3.0orlater). See [LICENSE](/OlegIGalkin/tendayweekcalendar/blob/main/LICENSE) for the full text. Run locally 1. Install dependencies: npm install 2. Start the development server: npm run dev 3. Build the app for production: npm run build Notes This repository contains the source code for the app and is suitable for publishing on GitHub. You can fork or adapt it freely, but the app relies on external services such as Google and Microsoft for calendar integration. [](/mukundzha/hazzel/blob/main/assets/logo.png) Hazzel A small terminal coding agent. Bring your own key. [](https://pypi.org/project/hazzel/) [](https://www.python.org/) [](/mukundzha/hazzel/blob/main/LICENSE) Hazzel lives in your terminal. It reads code, edits files, runs commands, and works with git — always with your approval first. [](/mukundzha/hazzel/blob/main/assets/demo.gif) pip install hazzel cd yourproject hazzel Run /model, pick a provider, paste your key. Keys are stored at ~/.config/hazzel/config.json with 0600 permissions. Env vars (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY) work too. Ollama runs local models with no key (OLLAMA_HOST overrides the default http://localhost:11434/v1). Windows works too (PowerShell or cmd) — the fullscreen menus gracefully fall back to plain prompts, no new dependencies. ❯ Fix the failing test in tests/test_agent.py ● read_file tests/test_agent.py ● edit_file src/hazzel/agent.py ● run_command pytest q — passed Why Hazzel? Most coding agents keep getting bigger. Hazzel stays small on purpose. The model suggests what to do. Hazzel decides whether and how to do it. Every mutation goes through you: file changes show a diff before they apply, shell commands ask first, and destructive git stays blocked. If you want the most featureheavy agent, there are better options. If you want a terminal agent you can see through, that's Hazzel. What it does Read, search, and list your codebase. Tag files with @path to put them in context. Create and edit files with diff preview and approval. Undo with /undo. Run shell commands with approval and timeout, sandboxed to your project root. Readonly cmds (ls, cat, git status…) skip approval. Plan mode (/plan on): readonly exploration. Hazzel proposes a numbered plan, changes nothing until you run /plan off. Prove mode (/prove on): smokechecks Python edits in /tmp before you trust them. Think mode (/think on): lets supported models reason stepbystep before answering — costs more tokens, wins on hard edits. Goal (/goal): pin an objective, run it with /goal run; every turn steers toward it until done. Gitnative: /status, /diff with file browser, /review with seniorlevel findings, /commit with suggested message, /branch, /log, /push, /pull, /sync. No force, no reset hard via shell. GitHub PRs via gh: /pr lists open PRs, /pr viewdiffchecks <n reads, /pr commentmergeclose <n and /pr create <title write (approval first, planmode readonly). Needs gh auth login. Model thinking stays collapsed behind an Entertoexpand prompt — peek only when curious. Read the web: fetch <url pulls public docs and references into context (readonly). AGENTS.md support: Hazzel reads the repolevel AGENTS.md on startup and merges it into the system prompt so repospecific instructions are always in context. Edits made midsession take effect after /clear or a restart. Multiline input: Ctrl+J for newlines, full multiline paste. Extras: /docs prints the full usage guide, /init drafts an AGENTS.md project map, /export saves the transcript, /copy grabs the last reply, /retry reruns your last message. Streams responses with perturn token usage (/usage). Providers Bring your own key. No subscription. items.author: mukundzha6
items.descZh: Hazzel 是一款轻量级、高安全性的终端编码代理，旨在将 AI 编程助手无缝融入终端工作流。它核心功能包括读写代码、执行沙箱化命令、管理 Git 仓库，并支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Groq（默认使用 openai/gpt-oss-120b 模型）及本地 Ollama 等多模型后端，API 密钥以 0600 权限安全存储。其核心亮点是极致的透明与可控性，所有文件修改均需通过 diff 预览且须用户批准，破坏性 git 操作被严格阻断，确保“模型建议、人工决策”的安全边界。此外，它内置计划（/plan）、验证（/prove）和推理（/think）模式，并能自动读取仓库级 AGENTS.md 以融合项目特定规范。该工具特别适合追求高安全性、高可审计性，且希望在终端中轻量化运行 AI 编码助手的开发者，适用于复杂的代码库重构与日常迭代开发。
items.quote: 如果你想要一个你可以看穿的终端代理，那就是 Hazzel。
